Announcing Cluster-SSG v1.0.0 🚀

Today we are proud to announce Cluster-SSG v1.0.0, an ultra-fast, zero-dependency static site generator.

Key Highlights

  • Pure Cluster: 100% written in Cluster language (.cl), compiled via LLVM to native machine code.
  • Native .cld Documents: High-speed document AST format replacing Markdown and JSON.
  • Astro Component Islands: Zero client JavaScript by default with selective partial hydration.
  • Binary Wire Page Security: Stream .clb binary bytecode directly to browsers to protect source markup and prevent scraping.
